text:
maya: seeing a weird latency spike on a few nodes during long-context sessions. tokens 800-1200 suddenly jump to 800-1200ms p99 today. started after the FIFO experiment on evicter.
alex: can you paste the KV metrics and whether this was under bursty interleaved access? FIFO usually helps throughput but can thrash if access mix is weird.
maya: yes interleaved small reads across ~40 sessions + a handful of long streaming writes. pattern is: session A reads keys a1..a50, session B writes b1..b10, sessions rotate. kv evict/reinsert counts explode.
chris: interesting — that pattern can create short reuse windows where FIFO evicts entries that are reinserted right after, causing a re-fetch cascade and pager activity. did you see page faults or IO waits?
maya: profiler attached below (snip) — top lines from the runtime probe:
```
kv_evict_count: 4123
kv_reinsert_count: 3987
kv_page_faults: 1124
avg_reuse_ms: 96.3
pager_io_wait_ms_p90: 420.1
batch_scheduler_poll_us: 240
hotpath_cpu: kv_reinsert_lock (38%), pager_io_thread (22%)
```
alex: that pager_io_wait is the smoking gun. FIFO reinsert churn is keeping KV working set oscillating into the pager under sustained interleaving. LRU would likely keep hot entries longer, but could still suffer fragmentation.
adarsh: also check kernel selection and batching heuristics — if batches are sized differently it changes access ordering and kv reuse. any recent batch-scheduling changes rolled out?
maya: yes — last deploy adjusted batch flush threshold down from 4ms -> 1ms to lower tail for short requests. suspect that increased more frequent smaller batches which changed the interleaving.
chris: that makes sense: smaller batches mean more frequent KV touches mixed across sessions, reducing temporal locality. two levers to test: revert batch flush threshold and try an adaptive reinsertion backoff in FIFO path to coalesce reinserts.
alex: can you run a quick experiment on canary nodes: enable LRU on two pods, revert batch flush on two pods, leave two as FIFO+1ms for control, and collect the same metrics? I'll script metric collection.
maya: will do. repro harness: run 40 sessions with pattern generator: 70% small read bursts (20 keys), 10% long streaming writes, 20% medium reads. generator is attached.
```
# rough harness
for i in range(40):
  if i % 10 == 0:
    simulate_long_stream(i)
  else:
    simulate_small_read_burst(i, 20)
```

maya: quick note — saw a correctness oddity once on FIFO: a reinsertion after eviction had an old tombstone flag set and produced an assert in debug mode. haven't reproduced consistently.
chris: that could be a race in the evicter <-> pager handshake when reinserting an entry that's concurrently being paged out. add extra sanity checks and stats:
 - increment tombstone_reinsert_count
 - log key ids for reinserts above threshold

adarsh: from perf side, also look at how kernel selection interacts: some kernels pin certain CPU for pager work; if those threads starve, reinserts backlog and spike latency. we should sample off-CPU stacks too.
sre-bot: deploy event: rolling canary update scheduled to 4471234605. notify #incidents if p99 > 700ms for > 5m.
alex: plan: run the three-arm canary for 30m, capture kv_evict/reinsert/page_fault metrics, and trace off-CPU stacks + batch scheduler histograms. maya, can you capture a flamegraph around kv_reinsert_lock?
maya: on it — will post results in this thread. initial hypothesis: small-batch flush + FIFO under interleaved access => reinsertion cascade -> pager thrash -> token-level tail latency spikes. mitigation candidates: LRU fallback, adaptive reinsert coalesce, or batch-flush rollback.
chris: also consider a light-weight probation period where freshly reinserted entries are temporarily pinned to avoid immediate eviction if workload shows short loops.
adarsh: agreed; keep changes behind flags. also add an automated test that simulates the interleaved access pattern to catch regressions in CI.
maya: thanks — starting canary now. will update with numbers.
sre-bot: canary started on pods [r-c-1,r-c-2,r-c-3] at 4471234580. monitoring kv metrics.
maya: update 4471234599: LRU canary p95 down 2.1x vs control, pager_io_wait p90 down 3x. FIFO+1ms still hitting spikes. posting full dump in logs channel.
alex: solid — good data to move forward with an LRU fallback and a reinsertion coalesce flag. will create follow-up issue for infra+runtime to prototype probation pin and add test harness.
maya: created issue: INF-1298 with data links. thumbs up if ok :thumbsup:
chris: :thumbsup:
adarsh: :+1:
